comment: She was my General Biology Lab teacher freshman year. Her class was tough but her grading was fair (think I got an A on all of my labs, but I had to work really hard for it) and unlike other Biology Lab professors at U of R, she did not take a sick pleasure in giving all of her students failing grades when they should have gotten an A.

A truly kind professor who is more than willing to help students understand the material. The figures and imagery that she references helps students grasp the material. Definitely take advantage of her instruction!

Helpful during office hours, but you must seek her out. Lectures are convoluted, jumpy and boring. Highly dependent on a powerpoint with only graphsfigures, so reviewing of the powerpoint before exams is not helpful. Tests are weirdly worded, tricky, LONG, and focus on strange minute details.
She's is a great lab teacher. She definitely knows her stuff and is very helpful during labs. She isn't too tough of a grader and is really willing to help outside of lab also.

Somewhat slow to return graded work, but a solid professor who provides all the resources you need in lecture or office hours to do well in the course. Expects you to really know the material for exams, which means you need to review everything she covers thoroughly.

Nice lady.  Helpful if you want to use office hours.  Tests and homework consist of oddly worded problems.  So not only do you need an answer you actually have to figure out what the question is actually asking.  Lectures tend to be boring, but it is cell and molec.

Dr. Stenger was ALWAYS flexible and helpful.  She is very accessible and wants to see all her students do well.  Her teaching style is very clear, and she gets the information across.  I highly recommend her!
Tests include excessive and picky details.  Extremely difficult.

Dr. Stenger is a very knowlegable and easy going professor.  I've had her in both lab and research situations, in addition to having her as a professor.  If you show her that you're making an effort to do well she will be more than happy to help you both in and outside of class

Dr. Stenger is extremely inflexible in terms of test makeups. I was in the hospital and missed one of her exams and she would not let me make it up. My final exam had to count for that test, and it really ruined my grade. She is not particularly clear or helpful, and she can be quite rude.

Dr. Stenger, from what I can tell from her lab section, is a generally nice woman who really wants to help her students.  She is clear and wants her students to do well.  I would recommend taking her especially over Boland.
